messages:
matt: FYI hitting a weird merge-slot contention in canary. p95 +90ms on small-batch workloads, allocs skewed to node B. Need quick eyes before merging PR 8459. :eyes:
anya: can you drop the bench artifacts?
matt: linked below — S3: https://s3.redwood/bench/3301234567/slot-contention.tar.gz
jordan: grabbing it now. did you repro locally or only in canary?
matt: repros only on canary canary-2; locally runs fine with same config. suspect scheduling + shardpack interaction.
sam: is this blocking merge? we have window at 16:00
matt: blocking for now — want another +1 on the allocator tweak in the PR. also want to run a quick microbench comparison (baseline vs branch)
jordan: ran a quick microbench on canary image, single-run numbers:
```
baseline: p50 12ms p95 78ms mem 1.9GB
branch:   p50 13ms p95 168ms mem 2.1GB
```
matt: whoa p95 doubled. that's the spike. logs show KV shard rebalances at the same time.
anya: can you paste the scheduler trace snippet?
matt: copy paste:
```
[2026-03-10T14:03:12Z] scheduler: assigned slot 42 -> node-b
[2026-03-10T14:03:12Z] shardpack: migrating kv shard 7
[2026-03-10T14:03:12Z] alloc: preempted batch 3 -> cold start
```
jordan: looks like pack migration + preempted batches cause KV cache misses.
sam: if it's cache-miss related can we try the hotpatch that pins shards during migration? small change in autoscale config.
matt: yep that's PR 8463 (hotpatch). I can push a canary with that change and run the same microbench.
ci-bot: deploy started for matt/patch-8463 -> canary-2 (job 7723)
matt: kicked off. I'll post numbers in ~10m.
anya: if numbers look good can we get a 2nd approve from jordan and sam? otherwise revert window is narrow.
jordan: happy to review if the perf improves. ping me when CI finishes.
sam: +1 to expedite, but want the bench artifacts before approving.
matt: got it — will upload results, tarball will be at the same S3 path with /8463 suffix.
matt: (later) quick results attached:
```
baseline: p50 12ms p95 78ms mem 1.9GB
branch (pre-hotpatch): p50 13ms p95 168ms mem 2.1GB
branch (hotpatch): p50 12ms p95 82ms mem 1.95GB
```
anya: that's promising, p95 back near baseline. any throughput impact?
jordan: throughput looks unchanged on the microbench. will run a 1h soak on canary-2 now.
sam: I'm good to approve once soak is clean and CI artifacts uploaded. :thumbsup:
matt: thanks all, leaving the merge on hold until soak completes. will update thread.
ci-bot: soak job started (job 7728) — ETA ~60m
